pred_texts: Instruct: Get a medium sized pan and add around three tablespoons of olive oil to the pan.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now turn on the heat to medium.
Instruct: Take two medium sized shallots and dice them into small pieces.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now very carefully add the shallots to the hot oil.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now take a spoon and keep stirring the shallots in the pan until they are soft to prevent burning. About  3 minutes.
Instruct: Now take around one cup of tomato sauce and add it to the pan with the shallots.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now stir the tomato and the shallots in the pan together.
Instruct: Now keep the pan at medium heat for about one minute and let it simmer.
Instruct: Now you can turn off the heat.
Instruct: Now take a medium sized pot and fill it halfway with water.
Instruct: Now put the pot on the stove and turn the heat on to medium.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now add about half tablespoon of salt to the water in the pot.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now take around three cups of pasta and add it to the water in the pot.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now stir the pasta in the pot.
Instruct: Now you can turn the heat to medium-high.
Instruct: Now wait until the water starts boiling, and then you can check if the pasta is done.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now turn off the heat and drain the water from the pasta.
Instruct: Now put the pasta in the pan with the tomato sauce.
Instruct: Now turn the stove with the pasta back on to medium heat.
Instruct: Now mix the pasta and the tomato sauce together. Make sure they are thoroughly mixed.
Instruct: Now take around 100 grams of mozzarella cheese and chop it up into very small pieces.
Instruct: Now add the mozzarella cheese to the pasta mixture.
Instruct: Now stir the pasta and the mozzarella cheese together. Make sure that the cheese is mixed well.
